summary: Plan only P1 (Platform and beta decisions) for dkirby-ms/animalvs: #23 account/progress protection rollup, #24 Entra External ID authentication, #25 authoritative durable state, #26 real-time reconnect recovery, #27 deletion/privacy, and #38 hosting constraints. User-selected stack: TypeScript + Express, Vue + Vite, PostgreSQL. Unknown tenant, environment, hosting-cost, and privacy details are explicit deferrals; production sign-in, hosting approval, and privacy acceptance remain blocked. Plan approval is still pending; no tracker mutations or P2-P8 implementation.

workspaceSignals.decisionReason: The workspace contains design and tracking documents but no application source, framework, renderer, datastore configuration, or deployment plan. Preserve the user's modified GDD without rewriting it.

questions.question: Confirm the P1 API boundary and issue coverage; revise here if necessary.
questions.recommendedChoice: #24: OAuth 2.0/OIDC against the existing Entra External ID external tenant, visible sign-in failures, saved-progress recovery, stable account identity, and local-only simulated identity behind an explicit development-only flag impossible to enable in production or mint production-valid identities. #25: durable account/display-name, per-animal XP/levels/welfare/training, turns/credits/resets, facilities/pending purchases, battle participants or CPU profile/mode/locked snapshots/conditions/rules versions/seed/events/outcome/awards, reward counters/reservations, and idempotent management records; account-scoped authorization and rejection of all client-supplied authoritative values; explicit errors rather than local progress fallback. #26: authenticated real-time notifications and authoritative snapshot recovery, including persisted battle/account recovery without rerunning simulation or awarding twice, with explicit lost-connection/unavailable-result errors. #27: verified deletion requests, account-linked deletion within 30 days subject to legally required retention and backup expiration; active-account history retention and data minimization. #38: review Azure and the proposed $50 USD/month ceiling, not an approved budget. #23: aggregate protection evidence from the delivery issues. Use server-authored fixtures and platform contracts to test future game-state shapes, not production combat, matchmaking, rewards, or facility mechanics.
questions.answer: #24 authentication and production-inaccessible development simulation; #25 complete durable state contracts and account authorization; #26 real-time snapshot recovery without duplicate simulation/rewards; #27 verified deletion/privacy; #38 hosting-constraint review; #23 protection rollup. Build only platform foundations and verification fixtures, not P2-P8 gameplay.
questions.rationale: Coverage derives from the user-selected six issues, the modified local GDD, the sprint P1 row, and exact acceptance criteria in the local issue snapshot. Snapshot milestone metadata is historical; the sprint document records later P1 assignments. P1 contract tests must not be presented as proof of later gameplay integration.

questions.question: Confirm the minimal browser surface needed to verify P1.
questions.recommendedChoice: Sign in/out with visible failures; authenticated account/snapshot display; connection/reconnect and retryable server-load errors; verified account-deletion request/status surface. Never substitute browser-local progress. No playable loop, facility/collection screens, battle presentation, art/audio, or 3D renderer implementation. A clearly isolated development/test harness may display server-authored fixtures for authorization and reconnect tests.
questions.answer: Minimal sign-in/out, saved-state recovery, connection/error visibility, and deletion request/status UI only; isolated platform verification fixtures, no P2-P8 gameplay or presentation.
questions.rationale: The requested milestone needs observable authentication, recovery, and privacy behavior, not all eight GDD screens.

questions.question: Which durable store should P1 use, subject to cost, transactions, backup/restore, and deletion review?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Incompatible with P1 durable-state acceptance; cannot yield an approvable P1 plan.

options.label: Blob Storage
options.description: Required if Azure Functions is selected or file/media storage enters scope; not a substitute for transactional game state.

options.label: Queue Storage
options.description: Only if a durable asynchronous deletion/recovery design requires it; not assumed.

options.label: PostgreSQL
options.description: Proposed transactional store for account, battle, idempotency, and deletion records; Azure SKU cost remains unvalidated.

options.label: CosmosDB
options.description: Requires explicit partition and cross-record consistency design plus cost review.

options.label: Redis
options.description: Optional ephemeral transport/cache only; not proposed as sole durable authority.

options.label: Azure SQL
options.description: Alternative transactional store; assess service tier, idle cost, backups, and deletion.

questions.rationale: Durability is required but the database is not decided. P1 has no media uploads or art-serving service and Express is only proposed, so no Blob Storage is currently recommended. Add Blob Storage if Functions or file/media handling is chosen. Do not promise that managed PostgreSQL plus hosting fits $50/month.

questions.header: P1 Completion Evidence and Renderer Deferral
questions.question: Confirm that P1 uses real identity/database/transport integration with server-authored fixtures for later gameplay contracts, while deferring the renderer and all P2-P8 gameplay. Confirm how later end-to-end gameplay evidence is tracked without falsely closing P1 criteria.

options.label: P1 platform contracts now; renderer and gameplay later
options.description: Plan restart/sign-in durability, cross-account denial and tampering tests, lost/duplicate/out-of-order notification recovery, no simulation/reward re-execution on snapshot reads, verified deletion and backup behavior, production simulation-flag rejection, and cost-review evidence. Explicitly label future gameplay integration evidence as deferred.

options.label: Clarify P1 exit evidence before planning
options.description: If fixtures cannot meet an existing issue criterion, retain that criterion as blocked/deferred rather than expanding into later milestones or claiming completion.

questions.recommendedChoice: P1 platform contracts now; renderer and gameplay later
questions.answer: Yes — P1 platform foundations and isolated server-authored fixtures only; renderer and P2-P8 gameplay later. Do not claim deferred gameplay integration evidence as complete.
questions.rationale: #23 is a rollup of #24/#25/#26/#27, with #38 gating provider-dependent choices. #26 references simulation and reward behavior implemented later; P1 must distinguish infrastructure guarantees and fixture evidence from real later gameplay acceptance. No 3D renderer choice is necessary for the proposed P1 surface.
